reviews.text: Austin has been taking care of our 14 year old dog for over a year. His attention to detail is superb and more importantly he loves our family member like she’s part of his own.  He notices her behavior, mood, and any quirks and adapts to keep her happy.  We highly recommend Kibble!

We absolutely love Brittany! She does the best job with our Bichon. It took us a long time to find a groomer that we can rely on to keep her looking good even when she comes in with mats in her hair. This week her matting was pretty bad but Brittany fixed her right up! It makes a huge difference to know our girl is in good hands when we drop her off.

Not sure if this business has changed ownership, but similar to several other reviews, the service and professionalism have both greatly declined. We will no longer be taking our pet here. Pet owner beware!!!!

Austin  at your Sherry Lane location in Dallas Texas is the very best groomer I've ever had.
He is by far the best employee you have and should be highly commented.
He has made it very clear that he wishes to build a relationship with his animals and is he is VERY kind and sincere with t he client.
I never want anybody but Austin to be with my Bostin terrier, Princess.
Please see that gets EVERY APPORTUNITY to advance and flourish within your company. He is a true jewel of your staff.
We love Britney! She has a fantastic demeanor with our nervous pup. She always does an excellent job.

I’ve been going to Kibble Pet Grooming for sometime and they kill it every time! I’ve been to both Preston and The Hill locations and service has been great at both. Most importantly my pup is happy and safe after his groom! :)
I have been coming here for over a year! Hands down the best place for my anxious poodle. He  always looks amazing!
Highly recommend. We’ve used many groomers at this location and all have been great!
Our dog, Obi, loves coming and we trust them to take care of him!
It’s always been a good experience for us.

If I could leave zero stars I would!
I’ve been coming here for a couple years and have recommended their services to many people as I had been pleased with my pets’ grooming. I recently brought my dog in for his routine haircut, and the groomer did a good job. However, when I got home, I noticed that he was licking his paw excessively and holding it up. Upon further investigation, I noticed that his right front paw pad was cut. I immediately contacted his vet to explain my findings, and they suggested an exam for the next morning. During his appointment, the vet confirmed that his paw pad had been cut which required sedation for suturing and bandaging and multiple medications which cost almost $500.
When I contacted Kibble Pet to discuss the problem, the groomer showed empathy for his accidental injury, but the manager was very defensive, rude, and inappropriate. She arrived at my place of employment (!!) to confront and threaten me, still denying any accountability. The harassment was completely unprofessional and made an already painful situation worse when she refused to accept any responsibility for the injury that occurred to my pet while in their care. Had the manager listened to my concerns and responded appropriately by acknowledging the injury, I would not have felt compelled to write a negative review.
What should have been a simple, safe grooming visit turned into stress, sadness, and unnecessary suffering for my Pablo. I trusted this place to treat my pet gently and professionally, but instead I’m left with vet bills, worry, and guilt for bringing my pet here. Our dogs can’t speak for themselves, so we have to. Please be careful where you take your pets, their safety is truly our top priority as pet owners.

I have been using Kibble for 4 years. The best was on Arapaho and Walnut Hill. This one on Sherry is the only one they have left and I never felt so discriminated on since Friday. Well nothing was wrong with my Princess and I got her grooming done for $57 and everyone loved her. Even one of the dogs was grooming was crying when she left. I will never in my life step foot in Kibble. See the picture below of the $57 work done. I realized I was being way over charged.

We have been going to the Hill location for a few years, and have always been satisfied. Our first time at this location and definitely THE LAST. If you have a Great Pyrenees or any dog with undercoat do NOT drop them off here - the groomer Crystal absolutely butchered our sweet pup.
We told them and it has been in our file for years “to do a Great Pyrenees cut” and instead they shaved her like a poodle. They shaved the undercoat in the middle of summer, what groomer does that?? - In the Texas sun and heat my dog has no hair to protect her skin or cool her.
Shame on you, calling yourself a “groomer”!
See pictures of the majestic coat before and the hideous look of after.

Best groomers in Dallas!
My poodle Brownie loves this place and he always looks perfect! The staff is super nice too!
My shin tzus always look so cute and clean! Kibble Pet Salon always does a a great job.
Always so kind and consistent with our dog’s groom
Unprofessional and it honestly looks closed.

I know everyone always says “I don’t typically leave reviews,” and I truly don’t. But I feel compelled to share my experience, especially when it comes to the well-being of my fur baby.

I’ve had my dog groomed here over 15 times, and while there have been a few inconveniences or mediocre experiences along the way, I’ve usually tried to look past them. For example, I was told I could select extras for the essential bundle, only to be told other times that I couldn’t. There were also inconsistencies with the number of extras included (is it four or five?), random charges for a poodle/doodle fee without prior notice, not grooming his paw pads, and failing to follow directions—such as shaving his tail, not cutting his ears like it says on his chart, and not using the correct length. Most recently, I’ve noticed an increase in random cuts on him after grooming sessions.

But this last visit was the breaking point. Upon arriving, I could already tell things weren’t going smoothly. A new groomer was assigned to my dog, and while I understand that everyone has to learn, she openly admitted that she was still figuring things out. She then proceeded to lay my dog on his back, and I had to quickly remind her that he has back issues, something that’s been in his chart from the start. It’s critical that this information is read and followed but seems apparent they don’t require new groomers to stay informed.

I dropped my dog off at 11 a.m., at the time of his appointment. By 3 p.m., I had heard nothing. After reaching out and getting no response. I called again, and was finally told that my dog still hadn’t started his cut and was only just bathed. I asked if he’d been given water or taken to potty spot to which I was told, "yeah.. we’ll do that." But when I called back to confirm due to the lack of confidence I had in the conversation due to the level of coherency the employee exhibited, I was met with 3 denied phone calls (I try to see the good in people and really hope they weren’t ignoring me, but I don’t feel good about it). The person on the phone then proceeded to tell me, they can’t do those things while the dog waits due to liability. So, I guess no water for dogs? I also learned that my dog had finished his bath by 11:30 a.m., meaning he had been sitting for over three and a half hours, waiting for his grooming to begin. Then, I was told it would be at least another 1.5 hours once they start the grooming So in total, 6 (maybe even more) hours on a 5lb poodle.

My husband immediately went and pick up our dog. It was clear this situation wasn’t getting better and started feeling almost inhumane—keeping a small dog without water or a bathroom break for six hours. This was an issue of overbooking and poor management, especially given that they overbooked a new, untrained groomer. It’s unfortunate, but Kibble Pet on Sherry Lane has shifted, and not in a positive direction.

When my husband picked up my dog, he was visibly shaking. Even if you don’t want to apologize, there was zero understanding or empathy toward the situation. I’m heartbroken for my little guy. I’m sure there are other details I’m forgetting, but I want others to know that this place does not prioritize the care and well-being of your pets. Please be cautious when choosing a groomer for your fur babies.

Took my Labrador retriever here, booked him for a bath, nails, and deshedding treatment. They told me it would take two hours. Came back two hours to them saying it would be another hour, only for them to call me thirty minutes later saying he wasn’t handling the drying the best and I could pick him up now. I get there and they said if I wanted him to be fully dry it would be another hour in the kennel dryer and they hadn’t even done his nails or the deshedding treatment. Charged an extra handling fee because they said he wasn’t aggressive but would try to avoid the hand dryer. They are supposed to be the professionals… AVOID if you have a large dog or don’t want to dry on your own after service.
I have a golden doodle who is very high energy and they always do a fantastic job on his grooming!

Love Kibble Pet Grooming!! The front desk staff is super friendly and we love our groomer Natalia. Our 10 month old golden retriever puppy has been visiting Kibble Prt Grooming since we got him and the experience has been amazing. He’s crazy and they are very patient with him and he always looks soo handsome after his visit with Natalia. If you’re in need of a groomer definitely check this place out! 10/10!!
Thank you so much for the five star review! We appreciate it, and hope to see you and your furry pup in again soon!
Excellent customer service. I’m very happy with my fur baby’s new look. Natalia did a great job and did exactly what I asked. I’ll be back!
Thank you so much for the five star review! We appreciate your business!

Wasn’t very happy with my dog’s cut, it’s kind of choppy and inconsistent in places. It also took almost 5 hours to get my dog back, which I think is a bit long. He also didn’t get a bandana and was doused in perfume which made the ride home hard. It was said in other reviews that you could hear staff telling dogs to be quiet, and I also heard that when I was waiting for him. The Kibble Pet at the Hill is much better, I recommend everyone go there instead.

This company is terrible and they have terrible customer service. They have no courtesy for their customer. I would stay far away from this place and find a different groomer. I will never go back to this place.

I’ve been coming to KPG off and on for several years. My most recent visit will be my last. At checkin I asked for the deshedding treatment and normal groom and to keep my Pomeranians hair full. They later called and said she was too matted …
We appreciate your feedback!
Thanks for the great service.
